- Cost sensitivity: product-led growth; prefers hosted to reduce ops but needs predictable cost once scale reached. Interested in Dedicated pricing if ARR committed.
- Models: prefer Llama-2 family (quantized variants) + an opt-in safety reranker. Want ability to route to smaller/cheaper variant for non-critical paths.
- Routing/fallback: require multi-region routing policy — primary eu-west, fallback to eu-central or neutral-region only if latency within SLA; legal prohibits routing EU-customer data outside EU without consent.
